name: Aviation
summary: The current shelf now separates powered-lift operating rules, eight federal pilot selections, a company-reported conforming-aircraft milestone, and a dated DARPA field-trial plan. It supports regulatory and selection stages while aircraft certification, approved operators, sites, flights, safety performance, and service remain distinct gates.
watch_questions: Which powered-lift programs obtain type, production, pilot, operator, and route approvals after the final operating rule?
Which of the eight eIPP selections produce executed agreements, named sites, approved aircraft, test plans, flights, safety data, and public findings?
Which airspace, vertiport, charging, weather, emergency-response, insurance, noise, and community constraints become binding in named places?
What formal FAA record resolves the Shuttle Landing Facility's displayed January 2026 license expiration?
Which carrier and airport measures preserve flight, passenger, accessibility, weather, schedule, and service denominators?
